description:
Advances: ancora.findings

Stage: L2 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
Ancora.Finding: the closed registry as enumerated in ancora.findings.registry_closed (30 codes; the plan said 26, the enumerated table after cutting spec/prose_too_short is 30, and the spec list is authoritative), every code with family, default severity, and a message function whose text carries the remedy; derived/unanchored_subject names the per-subject override. Ancora.Severity: error/warning/info/off, precedence config-off > trailer downgrade > config severity > registry default, findings carry severity_source. Ancora.Trailer: Spec-Ack: <code>=<info|warning>, downgrade-only, no presets, range-scanned git log base..HEAD --format=%B, unknown codes/severities warn on stderr [CONFIG]. Ancora.Config: keys default_base, test_paths, lib_paths, severities (one map validated against the registry), overrides (subject + code + severity + required reason; unknown subject/code fires config/invalid_value); no prose block; malformed YAML degrades to defaults with [CONFIG] stderr; unknown keys are findings. Ancora.ModalClass ported for guard 2 (or in L4). Moduledoc records the 04a M4 rejection: config and dep version are co-versioned in git. NOTICE entries for ported modules.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged_tests covering ancora.findings.registry_closed, registry_defaults, messages_carry_remedy, severity_precedence, info_visibility, trailer_grammar, config_schema, per_subject_overrides, config_coversioned_note
- Behaviors to demonstrate: ancora.findings.scenario.registry_closure, unanchored_message_names_override, off_beats_trailer, trailer_downgrades_config, trailer_cannot_raise, unknown_trailer_code, unknown_config_key, unknown_severity_code, malformed_yaml_degrades, override_missing_reason, override_scoped_to_subject, moduledoc_states_coversioning (info_hidden_by_default lands with L9 output)
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or named files plus mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora from the specled_ex checkout; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED run mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix test, mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused, run-until-green
  - Verifier tier: tagged tests for the ids above plus --stale; no full suite
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface (consumers: Gate in L9, Output in L5; until then the proving tests are the unit suite)
  - Fixture hygiene: config fixtures are tmp files; no named ETS; tests async
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test (severity precedence matrix, override validation branches)
- Call-site Integration: Ancora.Finding is consumed by Output (L5), Config validation (here), and Gate (L9); proving test now is the registry closure test and the config validation suite.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/{parser,schema,index,decision_parser,gate,output,derive}*
- lib/mix/tasks/**
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/finding.ex, lib/ancora/severity.ex, lib/ancora/trailer.ex, lib/ancora/config.ex, lib/ancora/modal_class.ex
- test/ancora/{finding,severity,trailer,config,modal_class}_test.exs, test/support/**
- NOTICE
- .spec/specs/ancora.findings.spec.md (acknowledging edits to requirement/scenario blocks only; never weakening)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no code outside the enumerated 30; adding one is a spec change first
- no trailer presets, no upgrade-by-trailer, no off-by-trailer
- no test_tags block, no realization keys, no env var other than ANCORA_SHOW_INFO

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora passes (from specled_ex checkout)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
